title.original: Piper: A Programmable Distributed Training System
title.zh: Piper：可编程的分布式训练系统
title.en: Piper: A Programmable Distributed Training System

inclusion_reason.zh: Piper 以统一训练 DAG IR、策略变换指令、编译器和策略无关运行时支持新并行方案，是可编程训练系统。
inclusion_reason.en: Piper supports new parallel strategies through a unified training-DAG IR, transformation directives, compiler, and strategy-agnostic runtime, making it a programmable training system.

abstract.zh: Piper 通过统一的全局训练 DAG 中间表示，把高层并行策略与底层执行运行时解耦，让用户用模型注释和调度指令组合新训练策略。
abstract.en: Piper decouples high-level parallel strategy from low-level execution through a unified global training-DAG IR, letting users compose strategies with model annotations and scheduling directives.

problem.zh: 生产训练栈依赖专家手工实现策略，通用框架又只内置有限并行模式，导致新并行技术难以组合、验证和迁移。
problem.en: Production stacks rely on experts to hand-implement strategies, while general frameworks hard-code a limited set of patterns, making new parallel techniques difficult to compose, validate, and port.

approach.zh: 用户声明少量注释与指令，每条指令对统一 IR 做语义变换；编译器再从变换后的全局图生成各设备执行计划。
approach.en: Users declare a small set of annotations and directives, each directive transforms the unified IR, and the compiler lowers the transformed global graph into per-device execution plans.

system_design.zh: 模型首先转换为包含计算与通信的全局 DAG，策略指令作为 IR pass 组合，编译阶段完成设备切分与调度，策略无关的分布式运行时负责执行。
system_design.en: The model becomes a global DAG spanning compute and communication, strategy directives compose as IR passes, compilation partitions and schedules devices, and a strategy-agnostic distributed runtime executes the plans.

key_results.zh: Piper 在常见 ZeRO 策略上保持与专用实现相当的性能，并能通过联合调度计算和通信表达更复杂的组合并行方案。
key_results.en: Piper matches specialized implementations on common ZeRO strategies and expresses more complex composed parallelism with gains from joint compute-communication scheduling.

limitations.zh: 可编程性仍受 IR 和指令语义覆盖范围约束；错误组合可能产生难以诊断的计划，编译成本和新算子支持也决定实际采用速度。
limitations.en: Programmability remains bounded by IR and directive coverage; invalid compositions can yield hard-to-debug plans, while compile cost and new-operator support affect adoption.

workloads: composed data, pipeline, and expert parallelism

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
